headline: LeBron Cosigns 2 Chainz New Single Per Instagram Post
body: DJ Akademiks shared an Instagram post on September 10, 2026, claiming LeBron James cosigned 2 Chainz's new single. The post garnered 2,602 likes and 973 comments. The claim appears to be a verified social media post but lacks direct confirmation from LeBron or 2 Chainz. This viral moment highlights the intersection of basketball and hip-hop culture.
